No demo1 shape rows0-5 cols1-5; exp outline rows0-6 cols0-6 minus ones — observed exactly matches full rect. Then why demo3 partial frames on left shape? Left comp bbox rows0-7? Actually comp3 spans rows12-14? The small shapes. Frame around big comp: output shows '0021111112' row0 etc — frame col2 rows0-6 and col9 rows0-6ish plus top row0 c2&c9, bottom row6 c2..c6? Honestly, given time pressure, best: implement solver f combining both verified pieces (fill: enclosed+adjacent-to-1 → 3; frame: exp-bbox outline → 2) and see how many demos pass, then refine per-demo diffs until all match.
